newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Exide and Israel's Tadiran in battery pact.
newsitem.headline: Exide and Israel's Tadiran in battery pact.

text.p: Israel's Tadiran Ltd said Thursday it reached an agreement with Exide Corp. of Bloomfield Hills, Mich., to jointly develop and produce lithium batteries.
Tadiran Chief Executive Officer Israel Zamir said the terms of the agreement had not yet been set and that it might include Exide's taking a stake in Tadiran's Tadiran Batteries unit.
The agreement covers lithium metal and lithium ion batteries, whose development has been pioneered by Tadiran, Zamir said.
Exide makes starting, lighting and ignition batteries and industrial lead acid batteries.

Tadiran said it had invested $20 million developing the batteries and another $10 million in building an automated production line capable of turning out about eight million of the batteries annually.
